summary: Mission Control is an interactive spacecraft engineering game developed by our team, AlazmaAstronauts. Players take the role of space engineers and make important decisions to plan a successful space mission. They choose a destination, select spacecraft components, manage a $150 million budget and a 1,200 kg weight limit, and test power, communication, and propulsion systems. The game challenges players to think critically, solve problems, and balance limited resources while ensuring mission safety and success. It makes learning about space engineering fun, realistic, and interactive.
details:
Mission Control is an interactive space engineering simulation game that allows players to become mission engineers and plan their own space missions. Players select spacecraft components, manage a $150 million budget, stay within a 1,200 kg weight limit, and make important decisions about power, communication, and propulsion systems.

The project makes learning about space engineering fun and engaging while developing critical thinking, teamwork, creativity, and problem-solving skills. Its intended impact is to inspire students to explore space science and understand the challenges of planning a successful space mission.

We used Canva to create the visual designs and Replit to build and host our interactive web application. ChatGPT assisted us with brainstorming, writing, and organizing project content.

Our project is creative because it transforms space engineering concepts into an interactive simulation where players learn through decisions and challenges. Our team considered budget limitations, spacecraft weight, power requirements, communication, propulsion, safety, and mission success.
